178.title: Fluency Talk · Choosing an adding strategy
178.hint: Look at the numbers first: are any of them close to a friendly number?
steps: If a number is close to a hundred or thousand, adjust the numbers.
If the numbers are easy to break into places, use partial sums.
Otherwise, the algorithm works for any numbers.
178.answer: Sample answer: I look at the numbers. If one is close to a friendly number like 1,100, I adjust the numbers. If not, I use partial sums or the algorithm.
178.verification: Discussion prompt with no single answer; sample matches the strategies shown in the Fluency Strategy box.

178.title: Fluency Talk · Why regroup when subtracting?
178.hint: What happens when the top digit in a column is smaller than the bottom digit?
steps: Look at 824 − 76: in the ones, 4 is less than 6.
Trade 1 ten for 10 ones so you have enough to subtract.
178.answer: Sample answer: When a digit on top is smaller than the digit below it, I regroup 1 from the next place (like 1 ten for 10 ones) so I have enough to subtract.
178.verification: Discussion prompt with no single answer; sample checked with 824 − 76 (4 < 6 in the ones needs regrouping).
